name: Citizenship by Naturalization

requirements.blocker_text: Constitution Article 148: an adult foreigner with a minimum of 3 years' residency in Paraguay, practicing a profession, trade, science, art, or industry, and of good conduct as defined by law, may naturalize. In practice (per immigration-practitioner guidance, not the constitutional text itself, which does not distinguish temporary from permanent residency), this 3-year clock is interpreted as 3 years specifically as a PERMANENT resident, typically reached after roughly 2 years as a temporary resident first -- meaning close to 5 years' total time in-country in the ordinary case. The applicant must also pass a Supreme Court written exam (30 points total, 21/70% required to pass; Acordada 464/07) covering basic Spanish or Guarani, Paraguayan history and geography, and the constitutional rules on loss of nationality. Court fee: Gs. 43,051. 14 supporting documents required, including birth certificate, passport, criminal records, and a residence certificate.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate the required residency period (roughly 2 years temporary + 3 years permanent in practice), maintain a clean record, and pass the Supreme Court naturalization exam.

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of a Paraguayan citizen (no accelerated timeline)

requirements.blocker_text: Law 2193/2003 grants a foreign spouse of a Paraguayan citizen immediate Permanent Residency (see py_family_reunification.json), but does NOT accelerate the citizenship timeline itself -- the spouse must still separately satisfy Article 148's standard naturalization requirements above. This is a genuine absence of a marriage-based citizenship shortcut, not this dataset's inference.
requirements.fix_path: Use the Ley 2193/2003 family-residency pathway to obtain Permanent Residency immediately, then meet the same standard naturalization requirements as any other applicant (3 years as permanent resident, exam, clean record).

evidence_required.document: Supreme Court naturalization exam pass (21/30 points)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 3 years as a permanent resident (per practitioner interpretation of Article 148)
